january: The first month, named after a two-faced Roman god
march: Month named after the Roman god of war
april: The month that starts with Fools' Day
may: Fifth month; ends with Memorial Day in the US
june: Sixth month, with the northern summer solstice
july: Seventh month, named after Julius Caesar
august: Eighth month, named after the first Roman emperor
september: Ninth month, though its name means "seventh"
october: The month that ends with Halloween
monday: The first workday of the week, named after the Moon
tuesday: Named after the Norse war god Tyr
thursday: Named after the Norse thunder god
friday: Last workday of the week, named after the goddess Frigg
saturday: Named after the planet with rings
sunday: Day of rest, named after our star
